rows.text: The LDP reports that the Diet-member voting and counting and the counting of the party-member ballots took place on 20 September 2006, and that 安倍晋三 won 464 votes (267 Diet-member votes, 197 member-derived votes) and was elected 21st president (第２１代総裁); 麻生太郎 received 136 (69/67) and 谷垣禎一 102 (66/36).

rows.text: After the election 安倍新総裁 (surname and title in this sentence; the article names 安倍晋三 in full) addressed the joint plenary meeting of party Diet members held in place of the party convention (党大会に代わる両院議員総会), pledging to lead the party like past presidents.
